text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 1053 September 5, 1985
Subject Matter : Suspending the implementation of Executive Order No. 1046, entitled Providing for the
accelerated development of the footwear, leather and leathergoods manufacturing industries and creating the
Footwear and Leather Goods Development Board.
Date of Effectivity : September 5, 1985
